name: Weekly Agenda
description: A compact weekly agenda with a travelling day selector, time-anchored event cards and expandable meeting notes, including a considered empty day.

props.name: timezone
props.description: Display timezone for host-supplied local times.

props.name: days
props.description: Ordered days with events, local time labels and notes.

props.name: defaultDay
props.description: Initial day ID; missing IDs fall back to the first day.

props.name: onEventSelect
props.description: Called when an event disclosure is activated.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
